summary: Carlyle Private Equity Partners Fund, L.P. filed an 8-K covering two items: an unregistered sale of equity securities and a disclosure of Transactional Net Asset Value. On May 1, 2026, the Fund sold limited partnership units for aggregate consideration of approximately $9.3 million, with prices set at the April 30, 2026 Transactional NAV per unit. The sale was part of a continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. Item 8.01 explains the valuation process and expense limitation. This is a routine capital raise and valuation update, not a special situation.
